set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system syslog file messages any warn.command: set system syslog file messages any warning
set system syslog file messages any warn.explanation: 配置系统日志文件，记录任何警告级别的日志。

parameters.name: severity
parameters.explanation: 日志的严重级别，例如any表示任何级别。

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: 日志的具体级别，例如warning表示警告级别。

set system login user vty0.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication plain-text-password \"$1c.explanation: Configure the system login user's authentication as an explicit password.

set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.command: set firewall family inet filter anti-virus term deny-icmp from protocol icmp
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤规则，拒绝ICMP协议的数据包。

set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.command: set firewall family inet filter anti-virus
set firewall family inet filter anti-vir.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term deny-icmp.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then discard.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set class-of-service forwarding-class an.explanation: 配置服务质量（QoS）的转发类。

set class-of-service classifiers firewal.explanation: 配置服务质量（QoS）的分类器，基于防火墙过滤器。

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet filter output [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family inet filter output anti-virus
set interfaces ge-2/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的输出方向防火墙过滤器。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
